posts.name: Aniruddha Jagdale
posts.cooked:
Hi @sayan ,

I may not have cleared the OPPE, but I want to know how marks are given in OPPE? The reason I ask is, when I couldn’t solve any OPPE problem in first attempt I got 3 marks, but when I could solve at least one problem, I got 2 marks. So just want to know how it works?

Kind regards,

Aniruddha

posts.name: Manas Agrawal
posts.cooked:
Hello Everyone,

This is regarding the re-oppe exam scheduled on 24th August. I want to know that how the marks distribution is done because in oppe 1 I solved only 1 question and my score was 23.00. But this time according to my solution and no. of test cases passed (both public and private) my score should be 44.00 .

But in the dashboard it is 40.00, So what is the scoring pattern based on test cases if I have passed :

Q 1. All public test cases passed . 4/10 private test cases passed.

Q 4 . All public test cases passed. No private test cases passed.

Q 5. All public and private test cases passed .

Therefore based on current score (40.00) will I get the course grade in System Commands or my oppe score would be 44 as I am expecting it to be . Please clarify the issue and scoring pattern for above scenerio.

posts.name: Aniruddha Jagdale
posts.cooked: I’ve also raised a question regarding marking strategy.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Qs 3 (both slots) had an empty test case, so you could get \frac{1}{7}\times20 marks with a wrong solution as well. If you solve Qs 3 fully, you get 20 for it.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
@23f3003513

You got \frac{1}{10}\times100 in first question, 0 in rest. Giving you a total of 2 with equal weightage to all questions.
